integrity.proof_method: Rank-and-atom counting followed by flag-adapted linear automorphisms and Gaussian graph-lift enumeration.
integrity.scientific_review: Correctness, originality and value assessed against stated scope; independent audit not performed.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns stable colour classes versus automorphism orbits in the full strict-inclusion subspace lattice; no identification among arbitrary finite posets or relational structures is asserted.
Marked subspaces must form a nested flag; incomparable anchor families and cover-edge-only representations are outside the claim.
The global two-round bound is sharp, but not every instance needs both rounds.
Finite computational tests corroborate, and do not establish, the arbitrary-dimension proof.
Publication priority against specialized earlier literature is not independently established.
title: Two-round orbit recovery for flag-marked finite subspace lattices
